title: 切內里基線隧道~Ceneri Base Tunnel
focus: 基線路線、雙孔軌道與系統整合~Base alignment, twin-bore track and system integration
summary: 切內里是瑞士新阿爾卑斯鐵路線的南段關鍵，官方資料列長15.4公里並於2020年底全面營運。本課由縱坡與列車需求出發，連接施工物流、軌道基準、隧道氣動和設備交付；學員須解釋土建完成之後仍有哪些測試才能支持完整鐵路服務。~Ceneri is a southern link of the Swiss new transalpine railway, officially described as 15.4 km and fully operational at the end of 2020. Starting with gradient and train demand, this course connects construction logistics, track reference systems, tunnel aerodynamics and equipment handover to the evidence needed beyond civil completion.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 將切內里基線孔與兩端接線分開，研究站間時間與隧道內行程不是同一計量邊界。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Separate the base bore from its approaches and distinguish station-to-station time from travel within the tunnel. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=13.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=13.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為14.96 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=13.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=13.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 14.96 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 忽略站外接線會把隧道理論節時當成全線實際節時。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Omitting approaches equates theoretical tunnel savings with whole-route savings. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：比較相同端點的路線和停站假設，保留接線速度限制。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Compare equal endpoints and stopping assumptions while retaining approach speed restrictions. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 基線縱坡與牽引需求~Base-alignment grade and traction demand
units.mechanism: 以切內里低坡度路線連接區域與長途列車為題，分析相同坡度對不同質量列車的牽引需求。基線鐵路用較小縱坡降低重載列車的重力阻力，但仍有滾動、空氣阻力及加速需求。土建線形和供電容量必須使用同一列車與速度情境，短距陡坡也不能被平均坡度掩蓋；制動方向的能量處理則是另一個需要獨立檢核的工況。~Use the low-gradient link to compare traction demand for regional and long-distance trains with different masses. A base alignment reduces heavy-train gravity resistance through gentler gradients, but rolling resistance, aerodynamic drag and acceleration remain. Civil geometry and power capacity must use consistent train and speed cases. Short steep sections cannot be hidden in an average gradient, while braking energy in the opposite direction requires its own operating and electrical assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1436.5 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1436.5 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。以里程高程表逐段計算坡度，對照列車性能曲線和供電模型，另檢核低速牽引及下坡制動，不只比較平均功率。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Calculate local grades from chainage and elevation, compare with train-performance and power models, and separately check low-speed traction and downhill braking. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以空車質量估滿載運轉會低估坡度阻力，尤其混編比較。平均坡度低卻存在短陡坡時，峰值功率可能超過預估，速度下降又會增加區段占用時間，牽連營運容量。~Using empty mass understates grade resistance in loaded and mixed formations. A short steep grade can exceed power estimates despite a low average, reducing speed and extending block occupation with capacity consequences.
units.misconception: 基線隧道坡度很小，所以不必做牽引與制動分析。~A small base-tunnel gradient eliminates the need for traction and braking analysis.
units.practice: 本案「坡度阻力功率」的交付需回答：以同速同坡條件重算各列車質量的坡度分量。軌頂高程交付前，由土建、軌道、供電和營運共同確認同版線形及列車包絡，變更坡度時同步更新性能與容量計算。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the grade-resistance power handover must address the following evidence: Recalculate the grade component for each mass at equal speed and slope. Civil, track, power and operations teams approve one alignment and train envelope before handover; grade changes update both performance and capacity calculations.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 切內里山區教學剖面保留節理方向改變，分析同岩性不同構造如何影響掌子面穩定與探查布置。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~Retain changing joint orientation in a teaching section, examining how structure changes face behaviour even within the same rock type. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.2 無因次；通水面積=240 m²。Q=k i A=0.00264 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.002904 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.2 dimensionless; flow area=240 m². Q=k i A=0.00264 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.002904 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 同岩名即採同支護會漏掉新形成的可動節理塊體。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~Assigning support by rock name alone misses newly removable joint blocks. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：按方位而非只按岩名整理揭露資料，核對探孔代表性。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Organise exposures by orientation as well as lithology and check probe representativeness. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.anchor: 有效掘進利用率~Effective boring utilisation
units.title: 掘進利用率與設備停時~Boring utilisation and equipment downtime
units.mechanism: 比較切內里背景下的假想連續切削與循環開挖績效，將施工方法假設和正式工程史分開。TBM瞬時貫入率只描述刀盤切削的一段時間，拼裝、換刀、出渣與維修決定每天真正進尺。岩石強度與磨蝕性對刀具的影響不同，混合掌子面又產生不對稱作用；比較機器績效須按地質分區和停時原因分類，不能只排序最高進尺。~Compare hypothetical continuous cutting and cyclic excavation in the Ceneri setting, clearly separating teaching methods from documented construction history. Instantaneous penetration describes only active cutting; erection, cutter changes, muck handling and repairs determine daily advance. Strength and abrasivity affect cutters differently, while mixed faces impose asymmetric loading. Compare performance by ground domain and downtime cause, because the highest short-duration penetration rate can coexist with poor daily production and increased maintenance demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：切削速率=1.62 m/h；有效利用率=0.295 無因次。D=24vu=11.4696 m/day。僅把有效利用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為12.6166 m/day。邊界：平均循環模型，未表示地質轉換及停機分布；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: active penetration=1.62 m/h; utilisation=0.295 dimensionless. D=24vu=11.4696 m/day. Increasing only utilisation by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 12.6166 m/day. Boundary: Mean-cycle model without ground transitions or downtime distribution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對兩個假想班次使用相同總工時與完整停時分類。由時間戳分離切削、拼裝與故障，將刀具位置、磨耗量及推力扭矩對齊里程，檢查停時是否集中在特定地層。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Use equal total shift time and complete downtime classes for both hypothetical shifts. Separate cutting, erection and faults by timestamp; align cutter position, wear, thrust and torque with chainage and test clustering by ground type. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只以最快切削分鐘比較兩方法會誤判整班生產能力。只提高瞬時進尺可能使出渣或刀具超出有效工況，短暫改善後增加停機，平均進尺和零件壽命反而下降。~Comparing only the fastest cutting minutes misjudges whole-shift production. Higher instantaneous advance can overload cutters or muck transport and create longer stoppages that reduce average progress and component life.
units.misconception: 刀盤瞬間轉得更快就保證全工程平均進尺更高。~A faster instantaneous cutterhead speed guarantees higher project-average advance.
units.practice: 本案「有效掘進利用率」的交付需回答：對兩個假想班次使用相同總工時與完整停時分類。停機紀錄使用可追溯原因碼，把地質變化與設備故障分開統計，參數調整只能在設備和施工團隊核准程序內進行。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the effective boring utilisation handover must address the following evidence: Use equal total shift time and complete downtime classes for both hypothetical shifts. Use traceable downtime codes, separating geological change from equipment faults; parameter changes stay within procedures approved by equipment and construction teams.

units.title: 共享通道與運輸瓶頸~Shared access and transport bottlenecks
units.mechanism: 雙孔設備安裝同時進行時，軌道板、電纜與通風材料共用運輸通道，研究施工隊介面造成的等待。多工作面只有在供電、通風、出渣與材料供應同步充足時才增加總產量。共用豎井或軌道形成串聯瓶頸，排隊和維修窗口會降低名目容量；緩衝區太大又可能侵占通行與救援空間，因此不能單純把各面產能相加。~During simultaneous twin-bore installation, track components, cables and ventilation materials share access and create inter-team queues. Multiple headings increase output only when power, air, muck transport and materials support them together. Shared shafts or railways become serial bottlenecks, while queues and maintenance reduce nominal capacity. Large buffers may obstruct personnel and rescue access, so face capacities cannot simply be added without a network-level transport and storage check.
units.model: 原創教學假設：車輛數=4 個；每車載量=24 t；往返週期=34 min。C=N payload 60/T=169.412 t/h。僅把往返週期增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為154.011 t/h。邊界：無排隊理想循環，並非共享路段實際產能；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: vehicles=4 count; payload=24 t; cycle=34 min. C=N payload 60/T=169.412 t/h. Increasing only cycle by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 154.011 t/h. Boundary: Ideal cycle without queues, not actual shared-route production. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。以裝載質量、往返時間及排隊時間重建物流曲線，再核對緩衝占用、共用通道優先權與維修時段。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class. Reconstruct flow from payload, round-trip and queue times, then check buffer occupancy, shared-route priorities and maintenance periods. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 材料到場被列為完成安裝會高估可用工作面和剩餘窗口。把理想往返時間當全天常數會忽略交會等待與卸料堵塞，導致工作面停工或把材料堆入必要通道。~Treating delivery as installation completion overstates available work fronts and remaining time. Treating an ideal cycle as constant all day misses passing delays and unloading blockages, stopping headings or pushing material into essential access space.
units.misconception: 增加工作面就可以直接把各面的理論產量相加。~Adding headings allows their theoretical outputs to be summed directly.
units.practice: 本案「出渣運輸節拍」的交付需回答：按材料類別比較到場、卸載和實際安裝時間。每日排程同時標示人員、材料和維修的占用時段，任何物流改線先檢查通風與應變通道，不能只看運量提升。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the muck-transport cycle handover must address the following evidence: Compare arrival, unloading and installation times by material class. Schedules show personnel, materials and maintenance occupancy together; rerouting first checks ventilation and emergency access rather than only throughput gains.

units.title: 控制網與貫通誤差~Control network and breakthrough error
units.mechanism: 軌道與接觸網在切內里長孔內需共享幾何基準，分析土建控制點與軌道調整坐標之間的轉換。長隧道的微小方向誤差會沿距離累積，地下控制網又缺少直接衛星定位，必須把地表基準可靠傳到洞內。閉合差很小不代表無系統誤差；尺度、折光、儀器定向與高程基準可能共同偏移，誤差相關性也使平方和估算失真。~Track and overhead systems need a shared geometric reference; examine transformations from civil control to adjusted railway coordinates. Small orientation errors accumulate over long drives, while underground networks lack direct satellite positioning and depend on transferring surface control. A small closure does not exclude systematic bias: scale, refraction, orientation and vertical datum may shift together. Correlated errors also invalidate a naive root-sum-square combination of supposedly independent observations.
units.model: 原創教學假設：控制長度=3480 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0463967 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0463967 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 獨立核對軌頂高程、中心線和接觸網定位的版本。由獨立測量組複核地表到洞內的轉換，保留原始角距及溫度資料，用不同控制線比較方向與高程偏差。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Independently reconcile rail elevation, centreline and overhead positioning revisions. Independently check surface-to-tunnel transformations, retain raw angles, distances and temperatures, and compare orientation and elevation through separate control routes. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 不同基準各自閉合仍可能使設備淨空在介面處不足。共用錯誤基準可能讓兩組測量同時看似一致，直到貫通或軌道銜接才發現系統偏差，修正成本遠高於早期複核。~Individually closed networks can still create inadequate interface clearance if their references differ. A shared wrong datum can make separate surveys appear consistent until breakthrough or track connection exposes bias that is costly to correct.
units.misconception: 兩次閉合結果一致就能證明地下控制網沒有系統誤差。~Two matching closures prove that an underground network has no systematic error.
units.practice: 本案「方向角誤差」的交付需回答：獨立核對軌頂高程、中心線和接觸網定位的版本。貫通前凍結座標、尺度與高程版本，獨立組直接使用原始觀測重算；不得只傳遞整理好的坐標而遺失校正資訊。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the orientation error handover must address the following evidence: Independently reconcile rail elevation, centreline and overhead positioning revisions. Freeze coordinate, scale and height revisions before breakthrough; independent reviewers recompute raw observations rather than receiving only adjusted coordinates without corrections.

units.anchor: 入口壓力擾動~Portal pressure disturbance
units.title: 列車壓力波與動壓量級~Train pressure waves and dynamic-pressure scale
units.mechanism: 列車進出切內里孔口的壓力變化用來辨認氣動尺度，將動壓估算與實際壓力波幅及乘坐舒適分開。列車進洞壓縮前方空氣，波動在洞口、橫通道和斷面變化處傳播與反射。速度和阻塞比影響壓力量級，但不可壓動壓只是比較尺度，不能替代可壓縮瞬變計算；兩車交會、門位與列車外形都可能改變乘客及設備的壓力歷程。~Use entry and exit pressure changes to distinguish dynamic-pressure scale from actual wave amplitude and passenger comfort. A train entering a tunnel compresses the air ahead, producing waves reflected at portals, passages and section changes. Speed and blockage influence magnitude, but incompressible dynamic pressure is only a comparison scale, not a compressible transient solution. Train encounters, door states and vehicle shape change the pressure histories experienced by passengers and equipment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；列車速度=44 m/s。q=ρv²/2=1161.6 Pa。僅把列車速度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1405.54 Pa。邊界：不可壓動壓尺度，不是可壓縮列車壓力波解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: air density=1.2 kg/m³; train speed=44 m/s. q=ρv²/2=1161.6 Pa. Increasing only train speed by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1405.54 Pa. Boundary: Incompressible dynamic-pressure scale, not a compressible train pressure-wave solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 同步對齊列車速度、位置和不同距離壓力訊號。以相同列車編組、速度和門位量測多點壓力歷程，檢查峰值、上升時間及反射抵達時刻，而不只比較一個最大值。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Synchronise train speed, position and pressure signals at several distances. Measure pressure histories at several points with matching train formation, speed and door states, comparing rise time and reflection arrival as well as peaks. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把動壓直接當洞口壓力波會忽略阻塞比與反射。以單一動壓數字當允收值會漏掉壓力梯度與反射疊加，可能使門扇、密封或乘客舒適度需求被低估。~Equating dynamic pressure with portal waves omits blockage and reflection. Using one dynamic-pressure value for acceptance misses gradients and superposed reflections, understating demands on doors, seals or passenger comfort.
units.misconception: 動壓公式算出的數值就是長鐵路隧道完整壓力波。~A dynamic-pressure calculation is the complete pressure-wave prediction for a long rail tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「入口壓力擾動」的交付需回答：同步對齊列車速度、位置和不同距離壓力訊號。試車報告記錄編組、速度、溫度及門位版本，土建斷面變更與設備耐壓驗證共用同一氣動模型，不能各自選有利情境。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the portal pressure disturbance handover must address the following evidence: Synchronise train speed, position and pressure signals at several distances. Trial reports retain formation, speed, temperature and door revisions; civil changes and equipment-pressure checks share one aerodynamic model rather than selectively favourable cases.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 雙孔鐵路的撤離先要辨認事故孔與安全孔狀態，行走距離只是通行能力和資訊延遲的一部分。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Twin-bore railway evacuation first identifies incident and safe-bore states; walking distance is only part of accessibility and information delay. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=88 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=513 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為555.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=88 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=513 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 555.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 演練資料分列通知、下車、集結和步行階段。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Separate notification, detraining, assembly and walking in exercise records. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 忽略下車階段會使僅按步速的撤離時間過度樂觀。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Omitting detraining makes a walking-speed-only evacuation estimate optimistic. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：演練資料分列通知、下車、集結和步行階段。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Separate notification, detraining, assembly and walking in exercise records. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 切內里系統交付情境中，兩組供電或控制設備若共用冷卻與通訊，須分開分析表面冗餘和共同故障。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~For system handover, distinguish nominal redundancy from shared cooling and communications that can disable both power or control paths. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.014 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000196 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00023716 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.014 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000196 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00023716 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 沿供電及通訊拓樸逐點追查共用設備和切換紀錄。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace shared equipment and transfer records along power and communications topology. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 兩套主機同置一個失效環境不符合獨立失效率乘積假設。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~Two units exposed to one failing environment violate the independent-failure product assumption. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：沿供電及通訊拓樸逐點追查共用設備和切換紀錄。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace shared equipment and transfer records along power and communications topology. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 鐵路通車需要土建、軌道、供電和控制的測試證據連結，研究切內里背景下的設備交付缺口。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Railway commissioning needs linked civil, track, power and control test evidence; examine gaps in a Ceneri-style handover. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=104 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.6154 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為83.0769 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=104 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=84.6154 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 83.0769 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 從一個警報追到現場設備、測試程序和維修責任。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace one alarm to the field asset, test procedure and maintenance responsibility. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只有竣工圖而缺測試狀態，無法判斷設備是否已整合驗證。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~As-built drawings without test status do not establish integrated verification. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：從一個警報追到現場設備、測試程序和維修責任。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Ceneri Base Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Trace one alarm to the field asset, test procedure and maintenance responsibility. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「基線縱坡與牽引需求」，再獨立計算「控制網與貫通誤差」。原創教學假設：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg；縱坡=0.0052 無因次；速度=20 m/s。P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW。僅把縱坡增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為1436.5 kW。邊界：僅坡度阻力，不含滾動、氣動、加速及效率；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：控制長度=3480 m；方向偏角=2.5 arcsec。e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m。僅把方向偏角增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.0463967 m。邊界：小角度方向偏差，未加入控制網相關性及折光；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate base-alignment grade and traction demand, then independently calculate control network and breakthrough error. Original teaching assumptions: train mass=1.28e+06 kg; grade=0.0052 dimensionless; speed=20 m/s. P=mgiv/1000, g=9.81 m/s²=1305.91 kW. Increasing only grade by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 1436.5 kW. Boundary: Grade resistance only, excluding rolling, aerodynamic, acceleration and efficiency losses. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: control length=3480 m; orientation error=2.5 arcsec. e=Lθπ/(180×3600)=0.0421788 m. Increasing only orientation error by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.0463967 m. Boundary: Small-angle orientation error without network correlation or refraction. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 2020 年公開記錄：切內里基線隧道完成並於年底全面營運。切內里是瑞士新阿爾卑斯鐵路線的南段關鍵，官方資料列長15.4公里並於2020年底全面營運。本課由縱坡與列車需求出發，連接施工物流、軌道基準、隧道氣動和設備交付；學員須解釋土建完成之後仍有哪些測試才能支持完整鐵路服務。本課把「基線路線、雙孔軌道與系統整合」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 2020: Ceneri Base Tunnel is completed and enters full operation at year end. Ceneri is a southern link of the Swiss new transalpine railway, officially described as 15.4 km and fully operational at the end of 2020. Starting with gradient and train demand, this course connects construction logistics, track reference systems, tunnel aerodynamics and equipment handover to the evidence needed beyond civil completion. The course treats base alignment, twin-bore track and system integration as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 15.4 km，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 15.4 km; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
2020 年事件：切內里基線隧道完成並於年底全面營運。~2020 event: Ceneri Base Tunnel is completed and enters full operation at year end.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=13.6 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=13.6 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=13.6 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 13.6 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「坡度阻力功率」：列車質量=1.28e+06 kg，其餘輸入依單元，結果=1305.91 kW；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching grade-resistance power: train mass=1.28e+06 kg, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 1305.91 kW; not measured or accepted project data.
教學「出渣運輸節拍」：車輛數=4 個，其餘輸入依單元，結果=169.412 t/h；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching muck-transport cycle: vehicles=4 count, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 169.412 t/h; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「方向角誤差」：控制長度=3480 m，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.0421788 m；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching orientation error: control length=3480 m, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.0421788 m; not measured or accepted project data.
